title: Cannot create ORM mapping against view

milestone.title: 2.0 final
milestone.description: can be looked at during the beta release period for 2.0.

body:
### Describe the bug

When I follow the recipe to create a View, I get an error stating that ``ORM mappings can only be made against schema-level Table objects, not TableClause``. In the wiki, it says that it should work with SQLAlchemy 2.0

### To Reproduce

Copy-paste this code example: https://github.com/sqlalchemy/sqlalchemy/wiki/Views#sqlalchemy-14-20-version

### Error
